snippet.title: Orbitals - Opening Animation [All Languages]
snippet.description:
Introducing the opening cutscene and our full global cast of Orbitals! 

Each cast ensemble has been carefully selected to bring together an authentic experience. 
To see the full global cast for Orbitals in each language, read the list in our blog post here: https://www.orbitalsgame.com/post/opening-cutscene-and-global-voice-cast

We’ve partnered with Studio Massket, the animation house behind some of the most beloved and popular Japanese anime, to create classic, hand-crafted cutscenes for the game. With the goal to honour the medium, we worked closely with Studio Massket to really strive for that warm, nostalgic feeling to define this brand new universe. 

Orbitals will launch exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 on September 3rd and is available to pre-order now! https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/orbitals-switch-2/ 

A physical edition will launch alongside the digital edition of the game, as well as a Digital Deluxe edition of the game, which includes additional digital goodies. 

For more information, follow our official social channels: 

Official Game Website: www.orbitalsgame.com 
X / Twitter EN: https://x.com/OrbitalsGame 
X / Twitter JP: https://x.com/Orbitals_JP 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/orbitals_game/ 
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@orbitalsgame 
Discord: https://discord.gg/orbitals
